description: A person with diabetes has been tracking blood sugar readings on scraps of paper for 3 months. The data is messy with inconsistent date formats, mixed time categories, and scattered entries. Clean up the data at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/blood_sugar_messy.xlsx by: (1) Creating 'Organized Log' sheet with standardized columns: Date, Day of Week, Time Category (Fasting/Post-Meal/Bedtime only), Reading (mg/dL), Notes; (2) Sorting chronologically; (3) Applying conditional formatting to readings (green for target range, yellow for elevated, red for concerning, blue for low); (4) Creating 'Summary Analysis' sheet with average calculations by Time Category and percentage in target range. Save as blood_sugar_organized.xlsx.
